name: shell
title: Shell
description: Run programs, builds, tests and computation. Never use shell commands/scripts for work other tools cover: cat/head/tail/less→read; ls/tree→list; find→glob/find; grep/rg/ag→grep; file authoring via sed/awk/echo >/tee/heredoc→edit/apply_patch; git→git (-C <dir> for other folders); gh→github, except what it lacks (repo rename/settings, account switching); code structure→code_graph. Commands run in the foreground until completion. A read-type call placed after shell in one response runs only when shell ends; place independent reads before it.

command.description: Command. Bash: chain dependent commands with &&; multiline input via a quoted heredoc delimiter, not extra quoting/escape layers.

cwd.description: Working directory; default the Project. Use it instead of cd/Set-Location.

timeout_ms.description: Hard kill deadline in ms (omit or 0 = none); set one for throwaway probes so a slow check fails fast.
